title: Studio field inspector: a base field in display-patch mode disables API name, Type, Required, Remove and more with no reason — regression of objectui#12303 from #28860
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbWJDYbbtH6dhJNoboN

立卡门: ① 产品缺陷（回归），具名落点 + 复现（reach: 界面，Studio 打开只读包对象的一个字段，实测两次）
业务理由: #28860 让只读基础包的字段可以在配对的 .custom 包里改显示属性，这是新功能；但同时把 objectui#12303 给禁用控件加的「原因」包装绕掉了。现在管理员点 showcase 的字段，API 名、类型、必填、删除等控件灰着，悬停、Tab、读屏都没有原因，唯一的说明句在 BASIC 顶部、跟控件没有关联，往下滚就看不到。这是刚合入的回归，ux-conventions.disabled-control-reason 的回归行由 PASS 变 FAIL，在 18.3.0 发出去之前修掉成本最低。
动手的读者: domain:ui 席，`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` 约 L8585 `fieldRailReadOnly = readOnly && !(extWritable && fieldSel?.kind === 'field')`，与 `ObjectFieldInspector.tsx` 约 L827–831 的 `displayPatchOnly → locked`：display-patch 模式下被锁的控件也要套上带原因的包装（或把说明句用 aria-describedby 关联到每个被锁控件）。
查重: `field inspector display patch disabled reason` 22 命中、`fieldRailReadOnly` 0（均含已关）；最近邻 #28575（功能本身，已关）、#28579（清单改写，开），都不是缺陷卡。

QA-source: #28981 · ux-conventions.disabled-control-reason · A0, A1

## What happens
Since #28860 (#28575, this release's head) a field of a read-only base package opens the rail in display-patch mode (`[data-testid=field-base-patch-only]`). Label, Description, Help text, Placeholder and option labels stay editable. Everything else is disabled: API name, Type, Required, Unique, Default value, option values and colours, Track history, the CEL Visible/Read-only editors, Move up/down, and Remove.

Those disabled controls carry no reason:
- no `aria-describedby`, no `title`, no focusable described wrapper (`[data-disabled-reason]` is absent from the rail);
- no tooltip on hover;
- the one explanatory sentence, at the top of BASIC, is linked to no control and is off-screen when Remove, Track history or the CEL editors are hovered.

Before #28860 the same rail was read-only and objectui#12303's described panel wrapper explained every control; the checklist kept that as a regression row expected to pass.

Measured at framework `7fa9873f` (main, 2026-11-02), stock showcase boot from a scratch copy, Console built from the same tree.

## Reproduction
1. Boot the showcase; form sign-in as admin.
2. Open `/_console/studio/com.example.showcase/data?surface=object:showcase_task` → Form → field "Priority".
3. Read `getByTestId('field-apiname-input')`: disabled, `aria-describedby` null, `title` empty, no focusable described ancestor. Hover it, and "Remove Priority", for 1 s; Tab through the rail.
4. **Expected:** each disabled control explains itself on hover, on focus and to assistive tech.
5. **Actual:** no reason on any of the three. Reproduced on two fresh loads.

## Mechanism (read at 7fa9873f)
`fieldRailReadOnly` turns false for a base field with a writable pair, so the #12303 wrapper is skipped, while `ObjectFieldInspector.tsx` disables the non-whitelisted controls through `displayPatchOnly` with only the unlinked sentence.
